description: Confirm catalytic tetrad conservation in Hmg2-lineage orthologues by alignment, and plot paralogue retention across section Fumigati alongside the GO evidence-code profile of both paralogues
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
b=requests.get("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/biopython/biopython/master/Bio/Align/substitution_matrices/data/BLOSUM62",timeout=90).text
L=[l for l in b.split("\n") if l and not l.startswith("#")]; cols=L[0].split(); B={}
for l in L[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    if p:
        for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): B[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def nw(a,bb,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(bb);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1):Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);pY[0,j]=2
    sub=np.array([[B.get((x,y),-4) for y in bb] for x in a],np.int32)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mi1,Xi1,Yi1,si=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1],sub[i-1];Mi,Xi,Yi=M[i],Ix[i],Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(Mi1[j-1],Xi1[j-1],Yi1[j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(c));Mi[j]=c[k]+si[j-1];pM[i,j]=k
            c=(Mi1[j]+go,Xi1[j]+ge,Yi1[j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));Xi[j]=c[k];pX[i,j]=k
            c=(Mi[j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Yi[j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Yi[j]=c[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0:A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append(bb[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1:A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append("-");ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else:A.append("-");Bb.append(bb[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0:st=2
        if j==0 and i>0:st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))
def mapp(a1,a2,pa):
    ia=ib=0
    for x,y in zip(a1,a2):
        if x!="-":ia+=1
        if y!="-":ib+=1
        if ia==pa and x!="-":return (ib if y!="-" else None),y
    return None,None
def pid(a1,a2):
    pr=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x!="-" and y!="-"];return 100*sum(x==y for x,y in pr)/len(pr),len(pr)

def fa(acc): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
Q=fa("Q4WSY2"); qcat=Q[585:]                      # 586-1062
ORTH={"A. fischeri":"A1D2V6","A. lentulus":"A0ABQ0ZW08","A. viridinutans":"A0A9P3BV96","A. udagawae":"A0ABQ1AQ25"}
TET={744:"E",877:"K",953:"D",1049:"H"}
out=[]
for sp,acc in ORTH.items():
    s=fa(acc); scat=s[-480:]
    a1,a2=nw(qcat,scat); p,n=pid(a1,a2)
    rec={"species":sp,"accession":acc,"cat_identity_to_AfHmg2_%":round(p,1),"aligned_pairs":n}
    for pos,exp in TET.items():
        op,orr=mapp(a1,a2,pos-585)
        rec[f"res@Af{exp}{pos}"]=orr; rec[f"ok_{exp}{pos}"]=(orr==exp)
    out.append(rec)
O=pd.DataFrame(out); pd.set_option("display.width",240)
print("=== Hmg2-lineage orthologues: catalytic-domain identity to A. fumigatus Hmg2 and tetrad conservation ===")
print(O.to_string(index=False))
O.to_csv("hmg2_orthologue_tetrad_conservation.csv",index=False)

# ---- figure: paralogue retention + GO evidence provenance ----
F=pd.read_csv("fumigati_hmgr_paralogue_classification.csv")
F=F[F.j_hmg2.gt(0.25) | F.j_hmg1.gt(0.25)]
piv=F.groupby(["sp","nearest"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0).reindex(columns=["Hmg1-like","Hmg2-like"],fill_value=0)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
y=np.arange(len(piv))
ax[0].barh(y-0.19,piv["Hmg1-like"],0.38,color="#2f6690",label="Hmg1-like")
ax[0].barh(y+0.19,piv["Hmg2-like"],0.38,color="#d1495b",label="Hmg2-like")
ax[0].set_yticks(y);ax[0].set_yticklabels(piv.index,fontsize=8.5);ax[0].invert_yaxis()
ax[0].set_xlabel("HMG-CoA reductase genes in UniProtKB (IPR004554)")
ax[0].set_title("A distinct Hmg2 lineage is retained across section Fumigati\nand absent from A. clavatus, A. nidulans and A. niger",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
G=pd.read_csv("quickgo_annotations_hmg1_hmg2.csv")
ec=G.groupby(["protein","evidence"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
ec.plot(kind="barh",stacked=True,ax=ax[1],color=["#8ab17d","#e9c46a","#c1121f"])
ax[1].set_xlabel("number of GO annotations")
ax[1].set_title("Every Hmg2 GO annotation is IBA or IEA.\nThe one experimental term, GO:1900551 (TAFC biosynthesis, IMP),\nis on Hmg1 only",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(title="evidence code",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
